enrichment_basis.note: The resolved CCMAS Human Kinetics/Physical Education record contains education courses but no sport-science course body. Sport Science is therefore enriched from the published Human Kinetics and Sports Studies curriculum of the University of Nigeria, Nsukka.

external_domain_links.evidence: Human movement, exercise prescription, biomechanics, physiology, coaching, performance measurement and sports-injury courses.
Planning and management of intramural/interscholastic sport, competitive sport administration and sports programme supervision.
Fitness conditioning, exercise prescription and nutrition/ergogenic aids are explicit course areas.
The curriculum includes teaching practice, curriculum planning and methods/resources for conducting Human Kinetics programmes in schools.
Common sports injuries, first aid care and safety education are included.
